During the latter [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], a '''male Yinchorri''' was convicted for [[Death/Legends|murdering]] six other members of his [[Species/Legends|species]]. After the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Darth Plagueis]] helped the [[Yinchorri/Legends|Yinchorri]] to gain representation in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]], the Yinchorri [[Council of Elders (Yinchorri)|Council of Elders]] gave the criminal to Plagueis, as a gift. The [[Muun/Legends|Muun]] [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] imprisoned the Yinchorri on the planet [[Muunilinst/Legends|Muunilinst]] and there, he performed a number of experiments on the murderer, in an attempt to learn more about the natural resistance to [[Mind trick/Legends|Force persuasion]] that all Yinchorri possessed. After two [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of testing, Plagueis eventually developed a method by which he could bypass the murderer's [[The Force/Legends|Force]]-resistance and compel the Yinchorri to become placid.
